TITLE: Update on Access Privileges for Warehouse Automation Lead

TO: Department Heads and Security Oversight  
FROM: Internal Security Compliance  
DATE: May 5, 2025  
SUBJECT: Assignment of Access Badge Series to Stethe Birnaen

Stethe Birnaen has been assigned the access badge series DV-1700-A. This assignment supports her ongoing responsibilities related to warehouse automation at Zastama Industries. The logistics and security teams have confirmed that the badge series is appropriate for her role and the nature of her work.

The DV-1700-A series provides access to areas where automation systems are being developed, tested, and deployed. These areas are designated as restricted due to the complexity and sensitivity of the operations taking place. The badge series ensures that Stethe Birnaen can access these spaces as needed to perform her duties and collaborate with other stakeholders on automation initiatives.

This assignment follows a standard protocol for personnel whose roles require frequent or specialized access to secure environments. The security matrix for these areas has been reviewed, and the badge series has been aligned with the current access requirements for personnel working in automation integration. No deviations from the established access control process were required.

It should be noted that this badge series is not an indication of heightened concern or risk. Rather, it reflects the operational necessity for Stethe Birnaen to have timely and secure access to the spaces where her work is taking place. The badge series is fully integrated into our internal access control system, and all necessary security logs have been updated to reflect this assignment.

All departments should be aware of the access privileges associated with the DV-1700-A series. It is essential that access is not extended or misused in any way. Any unauthorized entry into restricted areas, or any deviation from established access protocols, will be flagged for review and may trigger an internal investigation.

Stethe Birnaen’s badge assignment is in full compliance with company policy. Routine security audits will continue to monitor access activity to ensure that it remains appropriate and within defined boundaries. Any future changes to access privileges will follow our established internal communication channels and be documented accordingly.

Stethe Birnaen will continue to work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that all automation efforts are carried out in a secure and efficient manner. This includes coordination with engineering and logistics teams to maintain compliance and mitigate any potential risks.
